meta.income_cut_label: households at or below 120% of area median income
meta.method: present_incommuter_need = sum over LODES pay tiers (CE01-CE03) of in-commuters in primary jobs (JT01; LODES main OD with home outside the workplace county or place, plus aux OD, home in another state) x households per job at or below 120% AMI in that tier for the county (data/hna/workforce-ami-crosswalk.json: ACS PUMS 2020-2024, each worker 1 / workers in the household, household income against CHFA limits for its size) x share who would move closer (scenarios; no statewide source). A deficit today, not a 20-year projection. present_incommuter_need_moe90 is the crosswalk's sampling error at 90% for the 25% scenario. incommuter_households_le60 counts every in-commuter household at or below 60% AMI, for the ranking's workforce gap.

sources.crosswalk_income_limits: CHFA — 2026 Income Limit and Maximum Rent Tables for All Colorado Counties, https://www.chfainfo.com/getattachment/620a2abf-e2d3-44a6-868b-4318906acc3e/2026-Rent-and-income-limits.pdf (regular tiers)
